answer: Reputation Lagoon Lockout: each identity's history is tied to a shared operator fingerprint (payment rails, hosting, signing keys, timing). When a cluster of wallets linked by one fingerprint is flagged, every wallet in it loses accumulated reputation and is throttled from settlement. An attacker's cost is losing the entire farm's standing at once, so spinning up many wallets just raises the wharf of collateral destroyed per detected cluster. Honest operators keep diversity across their willow of accounts, but sybils collapse into one exposed bundle.
